Assens is a Danish municipality featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report evaluates the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across Denmark, utilizing data from the Danish National Patient Register (LPR) and the Danish Stroke Database (DanStroke) to track key healthcare metrics [^src1]. 

Specifically, Assens is included in the detailed municipal breakdown for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke through anticoagulant therapy [^src1]. On page 94 of the report, data regarding stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients in Assens is presented as part of the DanStroke-based calculations [^src1]. The inclusion of all 98 Danish municipalities in this analysis underscores the report's role as a vital tool for local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system [^src1].
